GraceDeployment.Target: Offline Debian/Astra Linux installation with systemd API/worker services, SQLite data directory, verified backups and rollback-capable updates.
GraceDeployment.Notes: Every merge candidate must pass project CI and GRACE gates. Release promotion additionally follows the repository release gate, full offline bundle verification, backup/restore requirements and target-system acceptance. GitHub main must require pull requests, strict status checks and linear history; direct/force pushes are not part of the supported delivery path.
